review_reasoning: All callers supply positive divisors: nonempty numeric selections/groups or fixed2 for even medians.
After removing2/5 factors, residual divisor dividing the coefficient is equivalent to a reduced denominator containing only2/5; decimal exponent does not change this criterion.
Array-length divisors bound terminating long division to at most31 fractional iterations; fixed median divisor needs at most1.
Nonterminating cases retain the same12-digit coefficient-fraction cap and half-up implementation.
Both selection mean and chart mean share the corrected helper; median, null filtering, cancellation, independent rational values and fallback have regressions.
E2E assertions inspect actual aggregate cells and chart title text after UI interactions; they do not merely invoke the helper.
